      "snippet": "Yes: one script. You run it whenever you want. It will:

Ensure the canonical repo lives in Termux home ($HOME/metablooms-ltm)

If your repo currently lives in Downloads, it will migrate it once (copy/rsync)

Ingest from Downloads into the repo under the new canonical filesystem (research/raw, os/snapshots, etc.)

Normalize naming for anything ingested (MBN-1 compatible “MB__…__sha…”)

Commit + push to GitHub (fail-closed)

You do not need a daemon for this. A daemon is optional later.

Install "
